context:
Goal: the work goes on now, and you can overrule any coordinator pick.
Problem (goal): the coordinator took this undoable pick on Nov 12, 13:18 CST without asking you; it stands unless you choose b.
Based on (ruling): your Nov 11 token-audit ruling, whose cuts include end-of-turn checks that send their asks in one message so sessions waste fewer turns, cited by the coordinator.
Departs from: main's refusal names the line it wants but gives no text — the refusal also carries a draft of that line.
home: PR #2864 (stop checks send one message); decision guard-remedy-not-to-owner (a Stop refusal opens with one plain line for you, and its steps live in the record)

options.gain: A session fixes a refused report in one try, with fewer wasted turns.
options.how: When the report check refuses for a missing "Recovered:" or "Handoff gave:" line, its message carries a draft of that line for the session to check and use. Undo: revert the decision edit and the draft.
options.label: Keep the pick (Recommended)
options.lose: A session may paste the draft without checking it.

options.gain: Every such line is written fresh by the session.
options.how: The refusal names the missing line and gives no draft.
options.label: Overrule it
options.lose: An extra refused turn each time the line is missing.

reply: Filed: the pick stands. A report refusal carries a draft of the line it asks for (PR #2864).
short: Refusal carries a draft of its line
title: A report refusal carries a draft of the line it asks for
why: A coordinator pick you could not see before.
